title: Non-reciprocal responses to gene knockdown in genome-scale Perturb-seq screens: code, analysis plan and results
description: Code (Rust), prespecified analysis plan, result tables, figure source data and Lean 4 proofs for the study of the symmetric and skew-symmetric parts of the gene-by-gene response matrix in seven CRISPR interference Perturb-seq screens of six human cell lines. Derived tables of the X-Atlas/Orion screens are under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA).
